test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of July 2020, how many fundamental duties are meant for a citizen of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11.**__

 
• There are 11 Fundamental Duties.
 
• The idea of Fundamental Duties is inspired by the Constitution of the USSR. 
 
• These were incorporated in Part IV-A of the Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
